body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.86 (naive sector base rate 0.82) that: Coforge FY27 consolidated EBIT margin (company-reported) is >=16.0%. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/IT_MIDCAPS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.82 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', all-category fallback, n=5); SAC +12.6 pts x weight 0.333 (N=10) -> p = 0.86. Evidence: Q2FY27 (23-Oct-2026): FY27 consolidated EBIT guidance raised to 16% from 15.5% (May-2026); 'reported Q4 EBIT of 17%'. H1FY27 16.0% (Q1 16.0%, Q2 16.0%). FY26 14.4%. Resolution: YES if Coforge's reported FY27 consolidated EBIT margin (company definition, Q4 FY27 release/factsheet/call) is >= 16.0%, to one decimal. Screener OPM/depreciation is NOT used. Source: Coforge Q4 FY27 press release / factsheet (NSE) and earnings call transcript (investors.coforge.com). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.82 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', all-category fallback, n=5); SAC +12.6 pts x weight 0.333 (N=10) -> p = 0.86
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other IT mid-cap peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=5, too few in category so all-category peer rate used). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if Coforge's reported FY27 consolidated EBIT margin (company definition, Q4 FY27 release/factsheet/call) is >= 16.0%, to one decimal. Screener OPM/depreciation is NOT used.
data.resolution_source: Coforge Q4 FY27 press release / factsheet (NSE) and earnings call transcript (investors.coforge.com)

title: Paper call: Coforge FY27 consolidated EBIT margin (company-reported) is >=16.0%
